cohort: The study included 200 anaemic pregnant women (mean age 26.1 +/- 3.8 years) attending the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology at a Medical College and Hospital.
finding: Anaemia severity significantly correlated with adverse fetal outcomes, particularly preterm delivery and NICU admissions.
mod_finding: Severity of maternal anemia was significantly associated with the mode of delivery (p = 0.0001).
